chunks.subject: math
chunks.topicKh: ស្វ៊ីតរួម និងស្វ៊ីតរីក — លំហាត់ទី១ (ក, ខ, គ)
chunks.text:
លំហាត់ទី១: តើស្វ៊ីត (uₙ) ខាងក្រោមជាស្វ៊ីតរួម ឬរីក?

ក. uₙ = 3n² + 5n + 1 — យើងគណនា lim uₙ = lim(3n² + 5n + 1) = +∞ ដូចនេះ (uₙ) ជាស្វ៊ីតរីក។

ខ. uₙ = (n² + n)/(2n² + 5) — ចែកភាគយក និងភាគបែងដោយ n²: lim uₙ = lim[(1 + 1/n)/(2 + 5/n²)] = 1/2 ។ ដូចនេះ (uₙ) ជាស្វ៊ីតរួម។

គ. uₙ = sin(2n)/(5n) — ដោយ −1 ≤ sin(2n) ≤ 1 នាំឱ្យ −1/(5n) ≤ uₙ ≤ 1/(5n) ។ ដោយ lim(±1/5n) = 0 ដូចនេះ lim uₙ = 0 ។ (uₙ) ជាស្វ៊ីតរួម។
chunks.normalizedText: Exercise 1 parts a, b, c: Determine if sequences converge or diverge. (a) uₙ = 3n²+5n+1 diverges to +∞. (b) uₙ = (n²+n)/(2n²+5) converges to 1/2 by dividing numerator and denominator by n². (c) uₙ = sin(2n)/(5n) converges to 0 by the squeeze theorem since |sin(2n)| ≤ 1.

problem.textKh: តើស្វ៊ីត (uₙ) ខាងក្រោមជាស្វ៊ីតរួម ឬរីក? ក. uₙ = 3n² + 5n + 1, ខ. uₙ = (n² + n)/(2n² + 5), គ. uₙ = sin(2n)/(5n)
problem.text: Are the following sequences convergent or divergent? (a) uₙ = 3n²+5n+1, (b) uₙ = (n²+n)/(2n²+5), (c) uₙ = sin(2n)/(5n)

solutionSteps.textKh: ក. lim(3n² + 5n + 1) = +∞ ដូចនេះ (uₙ) ជាស្វ៊ីតរីក
solutionSteps.text: For (a): limit is +infinity, so the sequence diverges.
solutionSteps.explanationKh: ពហុបទដឹងថ្នាក់ខ្ពស់ → +∞
solutionSteps.explanation: Polynomial with positive leading coefficient grows without bound.

solutionSteps.textKh: ខ. ចែកភាគយក និងភាគបែងដោយ n²
solutionSteps.text: For (b): divide numerator and denominator by n² (highest power).
solutionSteps.explanationKh: ចែកដោយ n² ធ្វើឱ្យតួ 1/n និង 5/n² → 0
solutionSteps.explanation: After dividing by n², the extra terms vanish, giving limit 1/2.

solutionSteps.text: For (c): squeeze theorem — |sin(2n)| ≤ 1 gives |uₙ| ≤ 1/(5n) → 0.
solutionSteps.explanationKh: ដោយ sin មានដែនកំណត់ ±1 ហើយ 1/n → 0
solutionSteps.explanation: Sine is bounded so the oscillation gets squeezed to zero.

finalAnswer.textKh: ក. ស្វ៊ីតរីក, ខ. ស្វ៊ីតរួម (លីមីត = 1/2), គ. ស្វ៊ីតរួម (លីមីត = 0)
finalAnswer.text: a. divergent, b. convergent (limit = 1/2), c. convergent (limit = 0)

formulas.meaning: ចែកភាគយក-ភាគបែងដោយថ្នាក់ខ្ពស់បំផុត
ទ្វើអ្បប (squeeze theorem) ចំពោះ sin

chunks.subject: math
chunks.topicKh: ស្វ៊ីតរួម និងស្វ៊ីតរីក — លំហាត់ទី១ (ឃ, ង, ច)
chunks.text:
លំហាត់ទី១ (ឃ, ង, ច): 

ឃ. uₙ = 2n/(n³) + 3n³/(n²+5) ។ lim uₙ = lim(2/n²) + lim(3n/(1+5/n²)) = 0 + ∞ = +∞ ។ ស្វ៊ីតរីក។

ង. uₙ = n·sin(n)/(n²+1) = sin(n)/(n+1/n) ។ ដោយ −1 ≤ sin(n) ≤ 1 នាំឱ្យ −1/(n+1/n) ≤ uₙ ≤ 1/(n+1/n) → 0 ។ ស្វ៊ីតរួម លីមីត = 0 ។

ច. uₙ = 2 + 3/n + 4/n² ។ lim uₙ = 2 + 0 + 0 = 2 ។ ស្វ៊ីតរួម។
chunks.normalizedText: Exercise 1 parts d, e, f: (d) uₙ = 2n/(n³) + 3n³/(n²+5) diverges to +∞. (e) uₙ = n·sin(n)/(n²+1) converges to 0 by squeeze theorem. (f) uₙ = 2 + 3/n + 4/n² converges to 2.

problem.textKh: ឃ. uₙ = 2n/(n³+n²+5), ង. uₙ = n·sin(n)/(n²+1), ច. uₙ = 2 + 3/n + 4/n²
problem.text: d. uₙ = 2n/(n³)+3n³/(n²+5), e. uₙ = n·sin(n)/(n²+1), f. uₙ = 2 + 3/n + 4/n²

solutionSteps.text: For (d): the second term 3n grows without bound.
solutionSteps.explanation: The dominant term is 3n which diverges.

solutionSteps.text: For (e): squeeze theorem using |sin n| ≤ 1.
solutionSteps.explanation: Bounded numerator over growing denominator gives limit 0.

solutionSteps.text: For (f): terms with 1/n and 1/n² vanish.
solutionSteps.explanation: Constants dominate as extra terms go to zero.

finalAnswer.textKh: ឃ. ស្វ៊ីតរីក, ង. ស្វ៊ីតរួម (លីមីត = 0), ច. ស្វ៊ីតរួម (លីមីត = 2)
finalAnswer.text: d. divergent, e. convergent (limit = 0), f. convergent (limit = 2)

formulas.meaning: Squeeze theorem: sin bounded, denominator grows

chunks.subject: math
chunks.topicKh: គណនាលីមីតស្វ៊ីត — លំហាត់ទី២ (ក, ខ, គ, ឃ)
chunks.text:
លំហាត់ទី២: គណនាលីមីតស្វ៊ីតខាងក្រោម:

ក. lim (n²+3n+1)/(8n²+n+1) — ចែកដោយ n²: = (1 + 3/n + 1/n²)/(8 + 1/n + 1/n²) → 1/8

ខ. lim (5n³+n²+n)/(n²+n+1) — ចែកដោយ n²: = (5n + 1 + 1/n)/(1 + 1/n + 1/n²) → +∞

គ. lim [(5n³+1)^(1/n)] / [n + (1/n)^n] — ≈ lim 5n²/1 = +∞

ឃ. lim (n²+sin n)/(5n²+cos(πn)) — ដោយ lim(sin n/n²)=0 និង lim(cos(πn)/n²)=0 ហើយ lim = (1+0)/(5+0) = 1/5
chunks.normalizedText: Exercise 2: Compute sequence limits. (a) (n²+3n+1)/(8n²+n+1) → 1/8. (b) (5n³+n²+n)/(n²+n+1) → +∞. (c) (5n³+1)^(1/n)/(n+1/n^n) → +∞. (d) (n²+sin n)/(5n²+cos(πn)) → 1/5 by showing the oscillating terms vanish.

problem.textKh: គណនាលីមីតនៃស្វ៊ីតខាងក្រោម: ក. lim(n²+3n+1)/(8n²+n+1), ខ. lim(5n³+n²+n)/(n²+n+1), ឃ. lim(n²+sin n)/(5n²+cos πn)
problem.text: Compute: (a) lim(n²+3n+1)/(8n²+n+1), (b) lim(5n³+n²+n)/(n²+n+1), (d) lim(n²+sin n)/(5n²+cos πn)

solutionSteps.textKh: ក. ចែកភាគយក-ភាគបែងដោយ n² (ថ្នាក់ខ្ពស់បំផុត)
solutionSteps.text: Divide numerator and denominator by n².
solutionSteps.explanation: Same degree polynomial fraction: ratio of leading coefficients.

solutionSteps.textKh: ខ. ថ្នាក់ភាគយកខ្ពស់ជាងភាគបែង ដូចនេះ lim = +∞
solutionSteps.text: Degree of numerator (3) > degree of denominator (2), so limit is +∞.
solutionSteps.explanation: Numerator grows faster than denominator.

solutionSteps.textKh: ឃ. lim(sin n/n²) = 0 និង lim(cos(πn)/n²) = 0 ដោយ |sin|, |cos| ≤ 1
solutionSteps.text: The oscillating sin and cos terms are negligible compared to n².
solutionSteps.explanation: Bounded trig over n² → 0, so limit equals ratio of n² coefficients.

formulas.meaning: លីមីតនៃប្រភាគពហុបទដូចថ្នាក់ = ផ្នែកលេខថ្នាក់ខ្ពស់
sin bounded, n² grows — squeeze to zero

chunks.subject: math
chunks.topicKh: គណនាលីមីតស្វ៊ីត — លំហាត់ទី២ (ង, ច)
chunks.text:
លំហាត់ទី២ (ង, ច):

ង. lim (n² + cos²(n)) = lim n²(1 + cos²n/n²) ។ ដោយ lim n² = +∞ និង lim(cos²n/n²) = 0 ដូចនេះ lim(n²+cos²n) = +∞ ។ ស្វ៊ីតរីក។

ច. lim (√(5n³) − ∛(n³+1)) = lim n(∛5 − (1+1/n³)^(1/3)) — ចំពោះ ∛(5n³)=n∛5 និង ∛(n³+1)≈n ដូចនេះ lim = n(∛5 − 1) = +∞ ។
chunks.normalizedText: Exercise 2 parts e and f: (e) lim(n²+cos²n) = +∞ since n² dominates and cos²n/n²→0. (f) lim(∛(5n³) − ∛(n³+1)) = +∞ since ∛5 > 1.

problem.textKh: ង. lim(n² + cos²n), ច. lim(∛(5n³) − ∛(n³+1))
problem.text: e. lim(n² + cos²n), f. lim(cube_root(5n³) - cube_root(n³+1))

solutionSteps.text: Factor out n²; the trig part vanishes.
solutionSteps.explanation: cos²n is bounded so n² dominates.

solutionSteps.text: Cube-root of 5n³ is n·∛5 which exceeds n, so the difference grows.
solutionSteps.explanation: ∛5 > 1 so the sequence grows without bound.

formulas.meaning: សម្រួលឬសបីថ្នាក់ n³

chunks.subject: math
chunks.topicKh: គណនាលីមីតដោយស្គ្រប — លំហាត់ទី៣
chunks.normalizedText: Exercise 3: (a) lim(√(n+1)−√n) = 0 by rationalisation. (b) lim n(∛(n³+n)−n) = 1/3. (c) lim n(√(n²+1)−n) = 1/2. (d) lim n!/(n+1)!·(2/n)^n³ = 0.

problem.textKh: ក. lim(√(n+1)−√n), ខ. lim n(∛(n³+n)−n), គ. lim n(√(n²+1)−1), ឃ. lim n!/(n+1)!·(2/n)^n³
problem.text: a. lim(sqrt(n+1)-sqrt(n)), b. lim n(cbrt(n³+n)-n), c. lim n(sqrt(n²+1)-n)

solutionSteps.text: Rationalise by multiplying by the conjugate.
solutionSteps.explanation: Numerator stays 1, denominator grows as ~2√n.

solutionSteps.text: Multiply and divide by conjugate, then simplify.
solutionSteps.explanation: Divide numerator and denominator by n to evaluate the limit.

formulas.meaning: ស្គ្រប (rationalisation) ដោយប្រើទ្វេស
លំហាត់ស្គ្របដ៏គេហើយ

chunks.subject: math
chunks.topicKh: លំហាត់ទី៤: លីមីតដោយប្រើ uₙ₊₁/uₙ — uₙ = n³/2ⁿ, vₙ = 2ⁿ/n!
chunks.text:
លំហាត់ទី៤: យើងមាន uₙ = n³/2ⁿ, vₙ = 2ⁿ/n! ជាមួយ n! = n·(n−1)·…·2·1 ។

ក. គណនា lim(uₙ₊₁/uₙ) = lim[(n+1)³/2^(n+1)]·[2ⁿ/n³] = lim[(1+1/n)³/2] = 1/2 < 1 ។ ដូចនេះ lim uₙ = 0 ។

lim(vₙ₊₁/vₙ) = lim[2^(n+1)/(n+1)!]·[n!/2ⁿ] = lim 2/(n+1) = 0 < 1 ។ ដូចនេះ lim vₙ = 0 ។

ខ. គណនា lim(2ⁿ + n³)/(n! + n³) ។ ដោយ lim uₙ = 0 និង lim vₙ = 0 ដូចនេះ lim(2ⁿ/n!) = 0 ។ ហើយ (2ⁿ+n³)/(n!+n³) → 0 ។
chunks.normalizedText: Exercise 4: uₙ = n³/2ⁿ and vₙ = 2ⁿ/n!. (a) By computing ratio uₙ₊₁/uₙ → 1/2 < 1, both sequences converge to 0. (b) lim(2ⁿ+n³)/(n!+n³) = 0 since 2ⁿ/n! → 0.

problem.textKh: យើងមាន uₙ = n³/2ⁿ, vₙ = 2ⁿ/n! ។ ក. គណនា lim(uₙ₊₁/uₙ) និង lim(vₙ₊₁/vₙ) ។ ខ. គណនា lim(2ⁿ+n³)/(n!+n³) ។
problem.text: Given uₙ = n³/2ⁿ and vₙ = 2ⁿ/n!. a. Find lim(uₙ₊₁/uₙ) and lim(vₙ₊₁/vₙ). b. Find lim(2ⁿ+n³)/(n!+n³).

solutionSteps.textKh: ក. lim(uₙ₊₁/uₙ) = lim[(n+1)³·2ⁿ]/[2^(n+1)·n³] = lim(1+1/n)³/2 = 1/2 < 1 → lim uₙ = 0
solutionSteps.text: Ratio test: limit of ratio is 1/2 < 1, so uₙ → 0.
solutionSteps.explanation: When ratio limit < 1, the sequence converges to 0.

solutionSteps.text: For vₙ = 2ⁿ/n!, ratio 2/(n+1) → 0 < 1.
solutionSteps.explanation: Factorial grows faster than exponential.

solutionSteps.text: Both 2ⁿ/n! and 2ⁿ/n³ contribute but n! dominates everything.
solutionSteps.explanation: n! grows much faster than both 2ⁿ and n³.

formulas.meaning: បើ lim(uₙ₊₁/uₙ) < 1 ដូចនេះ lim uₙ = 0
n! ធំជាងលំដាប់អ្វី

chunks.subject: math
chunks.topicKh: លំហាត់ទី៥: លីមីតស្វ៊ីតកំណត់ដោយ recurrence (ក, ខ, គ)
chunks.normalizedText: Exercise 5: Limits of recurrence-defined sequences. (a) a₁=2, aₙ₊₁=(1/2)aₙ+3: find fixed point c=6, transform to geometric with ratio 1/2, lim aₙ = 6. (b) a₁=3, aₙ₊₁=2aₙ+5: ratio 2>1, sequence diverges to +∞. (c) a₁=1, aₙ₊₁=(1/3)aₙ+4/3: fixed point c=2, ratio 1/3, lim aₙ = 2.

problem.text: Find the limit of recursively defined sequences: a. a_{n+1}=(1/2)a_n+3, b. a_{n+1}=2a_n+5, c. a_{n+1}=(1/3)a_n+4/3

solutionSteps.textKh: ក. រកចំណុចថេរ c: c = c/2 + 3 → c = 6 ។ bₙ = aₙ − 6 ជាស្វ៊ីតធរណីមាត្រ q = 1/2
solutionSteps.text: Find fixed point c=6, then bₙ = aₙ−6 is geometric with ratio 1/2.
solutionSteps.explanation: |q|=1/2 < 1 so bₙ → 0 and aₙ → 6.

solutionSteps.textKh: ខ. c = 2c + 5 → c = −5 ។ bₙ = aₙ + 5 ជាស្វ៊ីតធរណីមាត្រ q = 2 > 1 → +∞
solutionSteps.text: Fixed point c = −5, ratio q = 2 > 1, sequence diverges.
solutionSteps.explanation: Common ratio > 1, so geometric sequence grows without bound.

solutionSteps.textKh: គ. c = c/3 + 4/3 → c = 2 ។ bₙ = aₙ − 2 ជាស្វ៊ីតធរណីមាត្រ q = 1/3 → 0
solutionSteps.text: Fixed point c=2, ratio 1/3, so aₙ → 2.
solutionSteps.explanation: |q|=1/3 < 1, geometric part vanishes.

finalAnswer.textKh: ក. lim aₙ = 6, ខ. lim aₙ = +∞ (ស្វ៊ីតរីក), គ. lim aₙ = 2
finalAnswer.text: a. limit = 6, b. diverges to +∞, c. limit = 2

chunks.topicKh: លំហាត់ទី១០-១១: លីមីតផ្នែក ដោយប្រើ squeeze theorem
chunks.text:
លំហាត់ទី១០: បាល់ធ្លាក់ចុះពីកម្ពស់ 6m ។ កម្ពស់ bounce នីមួយៗ = (2/3) × កម្ពស់មុន ។ ចម្ងាយសរុប S = lim Σ 6(2/3)ⁿ = 6/(1−2/3) = 18m ។

លំហាត់ទី១១ (ក): lim Π(1 − 1/k²) ពី k=2 ដល់ n ។ ផ្ដាច់: (1−1/k²) = (k²−1)/k² = [(k−1)(k+1)]/k² ។ ផ្ដាច់ Πcollapsed → [(1·3)/(2²)] × [(2·4)/(3²)] × … = (n+1)/(2n) → 1/2 ។

លំហាត់ទី១១ (ខ): lim Σ n/(n⁴+k) ។ ប្រើ squeeze: n²/(n⁴+n) ≤ Sₙ ≤ n²/(n⁴+1) ។ ទាំងពីរ → 1 ។ ដូចនេះ lim Sₙ = 1 ។
chunks.normalizedText: Ex10: Bouncing ball with initial height 6m, ratio 2/3. Total distance = 18m. Ex11a: Product limit lim Π(1−1/k²) = 1/2 via telescoping product. Ex11b: lim Σ n/(n⁴+k) = 1 using squeeze theorem on Riemann-like sum.

solutionSteps.textKh: លំ.11ខ: n²/(n⁴+n) ≤ Sₙ ≤ n²/(n⁴+1) ។ ទាំងពីរ → 1 → Sₙ → 1
solutionSteps.text: Squeeze: bound Sₙ between two expressions both converging to 1.
solutionSteps.explanation: Upper and lower bounds converge to same limit by squeeze theorem.

chunks.topicKh: លំហាត់ទី១២-១៣: លីមីតស្វ៊ីត aₙ = 1/(2+qⁿ) ចំពោះ q ផ្សេងៗ
chunks.text:
លំហាត់ទី១២: គណនា lim [(q−1)(q²+q)·(q⁴+q³+q²)·…·(q^(2n+1)+qⁿ+q^(n+1))] ដែល q = 1/√2 ។ 
ដោយ (q−1)(q²+q) = q³−1 ។ ដូចនេះ ផ្ដាច់ → (q³ⁿ−1)/(1+q+q²) ។ ចំពោះ q = 1/√2: q³ < 1 → q³ⁿ → 0 ។ lim = −1/(1+q+q²) ។

លំហាត់ទី១៣: aₙ = 1/(2+qⁿ) ។ សិក្សាលីមីត aₙ ចំពោះ n → ∞:
- qⁿ → +∞ (q > 1): lim aₙ = 0
- qⁿ → 1 (q = 1): lim aₙ = 1/3
- qⁿ → 0 (|q| < 1): lim aₙ = 1/2
- qⁿ → +∞ (q < −1 ): alternating sign → |qⁿ| → ∞, lim aₙ = 0
chunks.normalizedText: Ex12: Telescoping product limit with q=1/√2; result involves 1/(1+q+q²). Ex13: aₙ = 1/(2+qⁿ) — limit depends on q: 0 if q>1, 1/3 if q=1, 1/2 if |q|<1, 0 if q<−1.

problem.text: Ex13: Find lim aₙ where aₙ = 1/(2+qⁿ) for different values of q.

solutionSteps.text: When q > 1, qⁿ → ∞, so aₙ → 0.
solutionSteps.explanation: Denominator grows without bound.

solutionSteps.textKh: ករណី q = 1: qⁿ = 1 → aₙ = 1/3
solutionSteps.text: When q = 1, qⁿ = 1 always, so aₙ = 1/3.
solutionSteps.explanation: Constant sequence.

solutionSteps.text: When |q| < 1, qⁿ → 0, so aₙ → 1/2.
solutionSteps.explanation: Geometric decay of qⁿ leaves only the 2 in denominator.

solutionSteps.textKh: ករណី q < −1: |qⁿ| → ∞ → aₙ → 0 (ជាមួយសញ្ញាឆ្លាស់)
solutionSteps.text: When q < -1, |qⁿ| → ∞ with alternating sign, so aₙ → 0.
solutionSteps.explanation: Denominator dominates despite alternating sign.

chunks.topicKh: លំហាត់ទី១៥-១៦: ស៊េរីរួម ឬរីក ជាមួយ r², tan, n/(2n+5)
chunks.text:
លំហាត់ទី១៥: Σ r²/(r²+1)ⁿ ជាស៊េរីធរណីមាត្រ a₁=r², q=1/(r²+1) ។ ចំពោះ r≠0: |q|=1/(r²+1) < 1 → ស៊េរីរួម ។ ចំពោះ r=0: ស៊េរីជា Σ0 = 0 → ស៊េរីរួម ។ ដូចនេះ ស៊េរីរួម ចំពោះ r ទាំងអស់ ។

លំហាត់ទី១៦:
ក. Σ(2+cos(π/3))ⁿ = Σ(2+1/2)ⁿ = Σ(5/2)ⁿ — ស៊េរីធរណីមាត្រ q=5/2 > 1 → ស៊េរីរីក ។
ខ. Σ(tan(π/4))ⁿ = Σ1ⁿ — ស៊េរីធរណីមាត្រ q=1 → ស៊េរីរីក ។
គ. Σ n/(2n+5) — lim aₙ = 1/2 ≠ 0 → ស៊េរីរីក ។
ឃ. Σ (5−1)/4ⁿ = Σ(5/4ⁿ − 1/4ⁿ) — ស៊េរីធរណីមាត្រ q=1/4 < 1 → ស៊េរីរួម ផលបូក = 1 ។
chunks.normalizedText: Ex15: Σ r²/(r²+1)^n is geometric with q=1/(r²+1) < 1 for all real r, so always convergent. Ex16: (a) Σ(5/2)ⁿ diverges (q>1). (b) Σ(tan π/4)ⁿ = Σ1 diverges. (c) Σ n/(2n+5) diverges (general term → 1/2). (d) Σ(5−1)/4ⁿ converges, sum = 1.

problem.textKh: លំ.15: បង្ហាញ Σ r²/(r²+1)ⁿ រួម ចំពោះ r ទាំងអស់ ។ លំ.16: ក.Σ(2+cos π/3)ⁿ ខ.Σ(tan π/4)ⁿ គ.Σ n/(2n+5) ឃ.Σ(5−1)/4ⁿ

solutionSteps.text: For r ≠ 0: r²+1 > 1 so q = 1/(r²+1) < 1, series converges.
solutionSteps.explanation: Geometric series converges when |q| < 1.

solutionSteps.text: General term does not go to 0, so series diverges.
solutionSteps.explanation: Necessary condition for convergence: general term must → 0.

solutionSteps.text: Both sub-series converge with q=1/4; compute sum = 1.
solutionSteps.explanation: Split and sum each geometric sub-series.

finalAnswer.textKh: លំ.15: ស៊េរីរួម ចំពោះ r ទាំងអស់ ។ លំ.16: ក.រីក ខ.រីក គ.រីក ឃ.រួម
finalAnswer.text: Ex15: always convergent. Ex16: a. divergent, b. divergent, c. divergent, d. convergent.

chunks.subject: math
chunks.topicKh: គំនិតស្វ៊ីតរួម និងស្វ៊ីតរីក
chunks.text:
ស្វ៊ីតរួម (convergent sequence): ស្វ៊ីត (uₙ) ជាស្វ៊ីតរួម បើ lim uₙ = L ជាចំនួនពិតកំណត់ ។ ស្វ៊ីតរីក (divergent sequence): ស្វ៊ីត (uₙ) ជាស្វ៊ីតរីក បើ lim uₙ = ±∞ ឬ lim uₙ មិនមាន ។

បច្ចេកទេសសំខាន់:
1. ចែក numerator-denominator ដោយ n^k (k = ថ្នាក់ខ្ពស់)
2. ប្រើ squeeze theorem ចំពោះ sin, cos (ដែលជាចំនួនទាល់)
3. ប្រើ lim qⁿ = 0 (|q|<1), lim qⁿ = ∞ (q>1)
chunks.normalizedText: A sequence converges if its limit is a finite real number. It diverges if the limit is ±∞ or does not exist. Key techniques: (1) divide by highest power of n, (2) squeeze theorem for bounded trig functions, (3) use lim q^n = 0 for |q|<1.

formulas.meaning: ស្វ៊ីតរួម
Squeeze theorem ចំពោះ sin/n
lim qⁿ ចំពោះ |q| < 1
